settled.rule: One building, one representation: LiDAR 2022 parts > 2015 blocks with 2022 heights > City 2009 parts (larger first) > 2015 outlines and placeholders. An item overlapping a higher-ranked one by at least half of the smaller footprint is dropped; otherwise the overlap is cut away and parts under 4 m2 go.

core_check.note: In the 2022 core (scratchpad check, 27 Oct): 2009 base elevation minus 2022 ground 3 m outside, median -0.56 m (n 3,189); 2009 top minus 2022 roof max for elements over 40 m, median -2.57 m (n 732). No datum-sized offset; not an accuracy statement.
